name: UptimeRobot
whatYouLose: Geographically distributed checks and false-positive suppression
Managed alert delivery across many channels
A provider that remains online when your own infrastructure fails
prompt: Build a self-hosted uptime monitor for up to 25 HTTP endpoints. Run scheduled checks with timeout, expected status, optional keyword assertion, consecutive-failure thresholds, and response-time recording. Store incidents and check samples in SQLite, show a public status page and 30-day sparklines, and send alerts through one configurable webhook. Include maintenance windows, manual pause, retention cleanup, rate-safe scheduling, an environment-password admin, Docker deployment, and tests using local mock endpoints. Use Astro SSR and vanilla JavaScript.
notes: The software is small; the caveat is placement. Host it somewhere independent from the systems it monitors.
